body:
I presented “Telehealth and Continuity of Care in Mental Health Care Delivery: Evidence from a U.S. Nationwide Claims Database” in the Strome Research Seminar Series at Old Dominion University. It is not common to have a brown-bag research seminar series at the college level. In my opinion, it is a great idea because it truly brings fresh eyes from all other disciplines. I got questions from faculty and graduate students from areas like finance, marketing, management, economics, among others. The kind of feedback I got, especially on causal inference methods (e.g., identification strategy), was amazing. Really grateful for this opportunity.

This is joint work with Shenghan Li and Kingshuk K. Sinha.
summary: Telehealth, continuity of care, and a chance to share our ongoing work.
title: A seminar at Strome
